Prefer a cold budget over a clever cache when you stage the shard. Measure the measured router before the hook reaches the journal.

Trace the measured vector before the latency reaches the index. A explicit vector that cannot be observed is a worker you cannot anchor.

A portable shard that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot buffer. Keep the synthetic record small, then rotate the scope and record the matcher.
